name: Support deflection and agent productivity — Northwind Logistics

drivers.label: Tickets deflected to self-service

tickets_per_year.source: Zendesk ticket export, 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, shared by Dana Whitfield on 2026-07-14

deflection_rate.source: Three reference customers with comparable ticket mix reported 14%, 19%, and 24% in their first full year; midpoint taken and rounded down

cost_per_ticket.source: Fully loaded agent cost of $82,000 per year divided by 6,400 tickets handled per agent-year (26 per day across 246 working days), both from the Q2 2026 CX operating review

drivers.note: Ramp reflects the content build-out schedule: the knowledge base covers roughly 40% of ticket categories at go-live.

drivers.label: Reduced handle time on retained tickets

tickets_per_year.source: Zendesk ticket export, 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, shared by Dana Whitfield on 2026-07-14

deflection_rate.source: Same deflection assumption as the driver above; retained volume is the complement

minutes_saved.source: Time-and-motion sample of 40 tickets run by the CX ops team in June 2026 showed 1.4 to 2.6 minutes saved on suggested-reply acceptance

loaded_hourly_cost.source: Fully loaded agent cost of $82,000 divided by 2,080 working hours per year

drivers.note: Realization is haircut hard: time saved per ticket only converts to cash if it aggregates into headcount or absorbed growth, and Northwind has committed to absorbing growth rather than reducing headcount.

drivers.label: Reduced agent attrition and backfill cost

agents.source: Workday headcount report for the CX org, dated 2026-07-01 (20 front-line agents, excluding 3 team leads)

attrition_reduction.source: Northwind's exit interviews name repetitive ticket volume as the top driver in 31% of CX departures; a 4 point reduction assumes roughly one in eight of those departures is avoided

cost_per_backfill.source: Recruiting cost of $6,200 plus 11 weeks to full productivity at the loaded agent rate, per the 2026 CX onboarding model

drivers.note: Deliberately the weakest driver in the case. It is included because the customer raised it, and bounded at zero on the low side so a skeptical reader can zero it out without rebuilding the model.

costs.label: Platform subscription
costs.note: Platform fee plus 20 agent seats; year 1 list less the 12% multi-year discount, 3% uplift thereafter per the draft order form.

costs.label: Implementation, integration, and content migration
costs.note: Fixed-fee statement of work: 9 weeks, includes Zendesk and Salesforce integration.

costs.label: Northwind internal effort
costs.note: Content authoring and program management at loaded internal rates. Included because omitting customer-side effort is the single fastest way to lose a business case in procurement review.
